references.text: The same exhortation to keep God's statutes and laws, with the promise of life by doing them.
Command to keep all of God's statutes and laws and do them.
Same structure: keep my statutes and do them, linked to dwelling in the land.
Command to keep statutes and laws in order to enter and take possession of the land.
Statutes and laws are to be kept in the land they will take possession of.
Promise to dwell securely in the land when they keep God's commands.
Promise of security and blessing in the land through obedience to statutes and commands.
Blessings for keeping and doing all of God's commands.
Keeping all of God's commands brings security and freedom from shame.
The one who listens to wisdom shall dwell securely and be without fear.
Prophetic promise that Israel will dwell securely in their land under God's blessing.
Promise that Judah will be saved and Israel will dwell securely.
